sophia: Heads-up: PR #4799 touches SOC2 audit-log examples. I noticed the Python HMAC snippet still includes a literal example email in the call (even though comment says redact). Can we sanitize? cc @kevin @ana

kevin: which files?

sophia: docs/security/audit-pseudonymization.md and docs/sdk/python/audit_examples.md. There's also a curl CLI example that posts to /api/v1/audit — should be /api/v2.

ana: quick note from legal: do not change retention or redaction wording. Code examples can be adjusted but must add an "example-only" caution.

kevin: ok. i'll remove the literal email and show a placeholder plus a short note recommending HMAC with an env secret.

sophia: perfect. also please update any internal anchors that broke when we moved the retention section. I found one linking to #retention-policy.old which 404s.

ana: +1. Legal wants the PR description to include: "Docs-only: code examples sanitized and migrated to SDK v2. No policy or TTL changes."

kevin: proposed Python snippet replacement:

```py
import hmac, hashlib, os
from redwood_sdk import Client

SECRET = os.getenv('PSEUDO_KEY')

def pseudo(email):
    return hmac.new(SECRET.encode(), email.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

c = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
# DO NOT use real emails in examples; pass a placeholder or token
c.audit.log({'event': 'signup', 'actor': pseudo('<user@example.com>')})
```

sophia: that looks good. add a one-line caption under the snippet: "Example-only pseudonymization; consult security for production guidance."

kevin: done. i'll also update the curl example to v2:

curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v2/audit" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"event":"signup","actor":"<pseudonym>"}'

and fix the anchor to #retention-policy.

docs-bot: Preview deployed — https://deploy.preview.redwood/doc/5421230000 PR #4799 :white_check_mark:

ana: legal ok to proceed once the PR description has the required wording.

sophia: thanks — i'll QA the preview after kevin pushes and then merge. :thumbsup:
